enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back in bed. Arms at sides. Legs straight. Close eyes. Breathe in and out. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Stretch arm. Adjust pillow. Lie on back again. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up in bed. Sit up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Dry face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast (toast and tea) while checking phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out bread. Close fridge. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Take out mug and tea bag. Put tea bag in mug. Boil water in kettle. Pour water into mug. Wait for toast. Toast pops. Take out toast. Put on plate. Spread butter. Pick up phone. Check phone while eating toast and drinking tea. Finish. Put plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag and laptop for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt, pants, socks. Walk to desk. Pick up laptop and charger. Place in bag. Add notebook and pen. Zip bag. Pick up phone and keys. Put in pocket. Pick up bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit community centre
enriched_activities.desc: Put on backpack. Walk out door. Lock door with key. Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Walk to empty seat. Sit down. Place bag on lap. Take out phone. Check messages. Look out window. Bus reaches stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk two blocks. Enter community centre.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator: setting up rooms, coordinating volunteers, and running morning program sessions
enriched_activities.desc: Enter community centre. Greet colleagues. Open office. Turn on computer. Set up program room by rearranging chairs, setting up tables, placing materials. Greet volunteers. Assign tasks to volunteers. Answer volunteer questions. Welcome participants. Start morning session. Introduce speakers. Lead group activity. Monitor participants. Provide assistance. Distribute snacks. End session. Thank participants. Collect feedback forms. Clean up room. Update program notes on computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the community centre
enriched_activities.desc: Leave community centre. Walk to nearby café. Open door. Stand in line. Order sandwich and coffee. Pay cashier. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink coffee. Check phone. Scroll social media. Finish eating. Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk back to community centre. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working: facilitating afternoon community workshops, writing reports, and meeting partner organisations
enriched_activities.desc: Return to office. Open laptop. Review workshop materials. Walk to workshop room. Set up chairs and tables. Greet participants. Start workshop. Lead discussion. Divide into groups. Circulate to assist. Answer questions. End workshop. Return to office. Write report on computer. Attend meeting with partner organization. Greet partners. Discuss collaboration. Take notes. Agree on action items. Send follow-up email.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the community centre
enriched_activities.desc: Leave community centre. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Arrive at stop. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter apartment building. Climb stairs. Open apartment door. Enter home. Lock door. Put down bag.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash and chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan. Add oil and vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish. Put plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply soap. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place in drying rack. Wash cup. Rinse cup. Place in drying rack. Wash utensils. Rinse utensils. Place in drying rack. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Wipe sink. Put towel away. Turn off light.
Enter living room. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Check phone. Get snack from kitchen. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing program notes and planning tomorrow's activities on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Enter password. Open program notes. Read notes. Type updates. Open calendar. Schedule tasks. Check emails. Write to-do list. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and reading before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Put on pajamas. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still. Turn again. Continue sleeping. Stretch legs. Fold arms. Turn to back. Sigh. Breathe deeply. Turn to other side.
